description: Northwest Climate Data Resources is a web tool or resource listed in U.S. Climate Resilience Toolkit, a national climate-adaptation toolkit, published or maintained by USGS Northwest Climate Adaptation Science Center. This library offers datasets, maps, and tools related to climate change and climate change impacts in the Northwest. Organized by topics of importance to the Northwest community, the portal also includes links to species and ecosystem vulnerability assessments and climate adaptation databases. Information in the portal supports local, landscape, or regional planning and adaptation efforts. Coverage: the United States, or as stated on the tool page. The toolkit lists hazards: Drought, Extreme Heat, Flooding – General, Shifting Species, Habitats, and Ecosystems, Vector-Borne Disease. Assets: Aquatic and Marine Resources, Natural Areas and Wildlife, Property. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the toolkit page (no licence or terms statement seen). Caveats: this record was written from the toolkit page, which was read; the tool itself was not opened or run, its licence and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support climate-adaptation planning and exposure screening. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-us-climate-resilience-toolkit-catalogue.
